mailPlatforms.sentHelp: Invitations and other notifications that Provisa sends out.
mailPlatforms.platformsTitle: Mail platforms your sources connect to
mailPlatforms.platformsHelp: A source that reads mail signs in with a client your organization registers with the mail platform. Enter it here once; nobody adding a source sees it.

redirectHelp.google_workspace: Copy this into your OAuth client in the Google Cloud console, under Authorized redirect URIs.
redirectHelp.microsoft_365: In Microsoft Entra, open the app registration, choose Authentication, add a Web platform and paste this address as its redirect URI. The sign-in returns to this address in the browser of the person signing in, so a localhost address works only when they sign in on the machine Provisa runs on. Sources that read the organization's mailboxes do not use it.

mailPlatforms.sameAddressNote: People connecting a source must open Provisa at {{origin}}. Another name for the same machine (127.0.0.1 in place of localhost) will not complete the sign-in.
mailPlatforms.redirectUnknown: The redirect address cannot be shown because this deployment's public address is not set.
mailPlatforms.clientSecretKeep: Leave empty to keep the one already entered.

settingHelp.tenant: The directory your organization's Microsoft 365 accounts are in: its ID or its domain, as Microsoft Entra shows it on the app registration's Overview page.

mailPlatforms.organisationMailboxes: Allow sources that read the organization's mailboxes
mailPlatforms.organisationMailboxesHelp: Off: a source reads only the one mailbox a person connects. On: a source may read many mailboxes of the organization with the administrator's credential, and anyone who may read its tables reads every mailbox unless a row rule limits them.

organisationGrant.microsoft_365: For sources that read the organization's mailboxes, give the app registration the application permissions Mail.Read and User.Read.All and grant admin consent.
